profile.name: 事件序列器
profile.description: 事件序列器是一种实验时序控制设备，用于按预设顺序输出事件码或触发事件，以协调束线、探测器、电机或其他实验站设备的同步动作。它常用于加速器与同步辐射/自由电子激光实验中，实现扫描期间或采集过程中的精确定时控制。
profile.description_en: An event sequencer is a timing control instrument that outputs programmed event codes or trigger events in a defined order to coordinate synchronized actions among beamline equipment, detectors, motors, or other experimental devices. It is commonly used in accelerator and photon-science experiments for precise timing control during scans and data acquisition.
